That it happens in practice rests on two independent reproductions of the same signature (the independent verifier at first_event_after_ms=300047, and CI on 684b3d16 with the control seeing an event at 5ms), not on a demonstration.

One apparent hang during R6.5 verification was investigated before being treated as a regression: multi_session simply takes ~140s and was competing with another project's cargo test. It was confirmed green rather than assumed either way.
